# Event

An event that occurred during estate administration. The INHERIT document carries its own audit trail via the events array

Source: [`v3/event.json`](../../v3/event.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/event.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this event |
| `eventType` | one of `death_registered`, `will_located`, `will_read`, `executor_appointed`, `probate_applied`, `probate_granted`, `letters_of_administration_granted`, `asset_identified`, `asset_valued`, `asset_collected`, `asset_transferred`, `asset_sold`, `debt_identified`, `debt_paid`, `tax_return_filed`, `tax_clearance_received`, `distribution_made`, `estate_accounts_filed`, `estate_closed`, `claim_received`, … (+4 more) or `string` | yes | Type of event. Core types cover standard estate administration events. Extension types use x-inherit- prefix |
| `occurredAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | When the event occurred (ISO 8601 timestamp) |
| `trigger` | one of `court_action`, `executor_action`, `beneficiary_action`, `institutional_action`, `calendar_deadline`, `legislative_change`, `marketplace_action`, `system_generated` | | What initiated this event |
| `description` | `string` | | Human-readable description of the event |
| `affectedEntityIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | UUIDs of entities affected by this event |
| `affectedEntityTypes` | array of `string` | | Entity types affected (estate, asset, property, bequest, etc.) |
| `actor` | `object` | | The person, institution, or system that performed the action |
| `metadata` | `object` | | Type-specific metadata for this event. Structure depends on eventType |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
